# jsonc-parser 3.3.1

Microsoft's official UMD distribution, copied without changes from the npm
registry package `jsonc-parser@3.3.1`. Only `lib/umd` and `LICENSE.md` are vendored.
The helper loads `lib/umd/main.js` directly; no npm install is required.

- Upstream: https://github.com/microsoft/node-jsonc-parser
- Tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/jsonc-parser/-/jsonc-parser-3.3.1.tgz
- SHA-1: `f2a524b4f7fd11e3d791e559977ad60b98b798b4`
- Integrity: `sha512-HUgH65KyejrUFPvHFPbqOY0rsFip3Bo5wb4ngvdi1EpCYWUQDC5V+Y7mZws+DLkr4M//zQJoanu1SP+87Dv1oQ==`
